newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera picks up business in Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Nera picks up business in Latin America.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications group Nera ASA said on Tuesday investment in its Latin American operations had begun to yield results with several new orders.
Nera said it had won a 75 million crown frame agreement with Texcom of Chile for a range of telecommunications equipment over the next 18 to 24 months.
In Bolivia, Nera has signed a contract for delivery of an SDH radio link system for 12 million crowns with Entel, the country's provider of long distance and national telephone traffic.
The deal was Nera's first contract in Bolivia.

Nera said it had also clinched a deal with Telcel of Venezuela for delivery of the group's Access Link. The seven million crown agreement constituted the first phase of orders which could be in excess of 400 radio terminals over the next 12 months, it said.

"We meet hard competition, not at least from American companies in this part of the world," said Arnfinn Tveit, Chairman of the Board of Nera Latin America. "It is therefore satisfying to see a number of orders starting to come in."
